description: The image displays three pie charts comparing the distribution of responses across three categories — “W/o Demos” (gray), “Hard to Tell” (blue), and “W/ Demos” (teal) — for three different contexts: an overall aggregate, “Funny Reddit,” and “Unhealthy Comments.” The top chart, representing the overall distribution, shows 43.0% for “W/o Demos,” 22.9% for “Hard to Tell,” and 34.1% for “W/ Demos.” The bottom-left chart, labeled “Funny Reddit,” shows 41.5% for “W/o Demos,” 21.5% for “Hard to Tell,” and 37.1% for “W/ Demos.” The bottom-right chart, labeled “Unhealthy Comments,” shows 37.8% for “W/o Demos,” 27.4% for “Hard to Tell,” and 34.8% for “W/ Demos.” All charts use the same color-coding, with a legend at the top indicating the mapping of colors to categories. The slices are labeled with their exact percentages, and the charts are arranged to allow visual comparison across contexts, with the “W/o Demos” category consistently being the largest segment in each chart.
